news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Quinn Ewers traded to Jaguars
news.desc: Quinn Ewers has been traded to the Jacksonville Jaguars for a 2028 Day 3 pick swap.
news.impact: This feels like a vote of confidence in Malik Willis for Miami's side of things, as Ewers was their starter for a few weeks last season and wasn't all that bad. As for the Jaguars, it looks like they're trying to secure someone they can have confidence in as a backup behind Trevor Lawrence.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Brett Rypien likely to be released by Texans
news.desc: Brett Rypien is likely to be released by the Texans.
news.impact: Rypien is currently the third quarterback on the roster, so the team is rolling with CJ Stroud and Davis Mills. Don't be surprised if they bring back Rypien as an emergency third QB, however.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Ambry Thomas released by Eagles
news.desc: Ambry Thomas has been released by the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.impact: The veteran corner last played in 2023 with the 49ers and has been trying to find his way back onto the field since. He will have to continue his search elsewhere.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Hassan Haskins released by Patriots
news.desc: Hassan Haskins has been released by the New England Patriots after the team traded for Corey Kiner from the Cardinals.
news.impact: Haskins will look to find a new home elsewhere, though his chances of making a roster are slimming by the day.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Corey Kiner traded to the New England Patriots
news.desc: Corey Kiner has been traded to the New England Patriots for a seventh-round pick. In a corresponding move, the Pats released Hassan Haskins.
news.impact: The trade for Kiner is interesting. While the cost to acquire is minimal, you would think given the Patriots depth at running back at this point in the season, they'd be trading for Kiner based on special teams usage. But, he was barely used in that department by Arizona last year and all throughout college. He's not a receiving specialist; in fact, you could say he was the opposite. So the move is puzzling, but we will have to see how they plan on deploying the former Bearcat.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Bobby Okereke signs with the Panthers
news.desc: Bobby Okereke signed with the Panthers on Saturday.
news.impact: The Panthers were looking to add some veteran experience at the linebacker spot, and they did just that with Okereke. The 30-year-old is entering his eighth NFL season. Okereke started all 17 games for the Giants last season, racking up 143 total tackles with two interceptions and one sack.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Marvin Mims Jr. suffers bruised foot
news.desc: Broncos coach Sean Payton said WR Marvin Mims Jr. suffered a bruised foot in the Broncos final preseason game.
news.impact: Mims avoids a serious injury. He is expected to be fine with just a couple of weeks until the season.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Mecole Hardman Jr. released by Bills
news.desc: The Bills released WR Mecole Hardman Jr.
news.impact: Hardman appeared in only two games with the Bills last season. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) hopeful for Week 1
news.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said he is hopeful WR Emeka Egbuka will be available Week 1 against the Bengals.
news.impact: Egbuka has been working his way back from a toe injury during training camp. He is a WR2 with WR1 upside when healthy this season for fantasy managers.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) expected to be available Week 1
news.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said he expects WR Jalen McMillan to be available for Week 1 against the Bengals.
news.impact: McMillan has been battling through knee and leg injuries during training camp. He is expected to compete for the immediate WR3 role for Tampa Bay.
